_meta.valuePerPointNotes: INR values per point are conservative estimates based on best-effort transfer-partner redemption (Marriott Bonvoy for MR, KrisFlyer/AI for HSBC and EDGE). Real-world value varies.

categoryMultipliers.note: 5X MR via Reward Multiplier portal (now ShopWise post-Feb 2026) on e-vouchers and partner brands. Multiplier varies 5X-10X by brand.
5X MR on prepaid FHR stays via Amex Travel portal (Platinum/Centurion exclusive)

milestones.reward: Taj Stay voucher Rs.10000 (annual renewal benefit)

voucherTricks.trick: Buy Amazon/Flipkart/MakeMyTrip e-vouchers via Reward Multiplier (ShopWise) for 5X MR
voucherTricks.valueEstimate: ~2-2.5% effective return when redeemed via Marriott/airline partners

amex_platinum_charge.exclusionsNote: Fuel, insurance, utilities, cash excluded from base MR earn but DO count toward annual milestone targets and fee waivers (Amex India quirk).

categoryMultipliers.note: Up to 12X via HSBC Travel with Points portal (~4X uplift on top of base 3X)

hsbc_premier_mc.exclusionsNote: Effective Apr 1 2025: rent, tax, jewelry, education, e-wallets, fuel, bail/bond no longer earn. Utility & Insurance capped at Rs.1L/month for points. Accelerated earning capped at 18,000 points/month.
hsbc_premier_mc.transferPartnersNote: 20 partners total (15 airlines, 5 hotels), mostly 1:1, instant via HSBC mobile app. Periodic 50% transfer bonuses to Accor.

axis_magnus.baseEarnNote: 12 EDGE points per Rs.200 = 6 per Rs.100, on monthly spends up to Rs.1.5L. Effective Jun 20 2025.

categoryMultipliers.note: 35 EDGE points per Rs.200 (=17.5 per Rs.100) on incremental spends ABOVE Rs.1.5L/month, capped at credit limit + Rs.1.5L. Post-Jun 2025 devaluation.

axis_magnus.milestonesNote: Monthly Rs.1L milestone (25,000 bonus EDGE) was REMOVED in Jun 2025 devaluation.
axis_magnus.exclusionsNote: Effective Oct 1 2025 (category-based): Utility & Telecom, Rent (capped Rs.50k/month with 1% fee), Wallet, Government, Insurance, Gold/Jewellery, Fuel, Cash advances, Repayments excluded from rewards and fee waiver.
axis_magnus.transferPartnersNote: Annual cap 5L EDGE points/CustomerID. Marriott, Accor, Qatar REMOVED Apr 2 2026. ITC remains as indirect bridge to Marriott.

greyAreaTricks.trick: Pay rent via CRED/NoBroker — but only Rs.50k/month earns base EDGE with 1% fee
greyAreaTricks.warning: Rent above Rs.50k/month earns no points; rent typically excluded from fee waiver post-Oct 2025.

axis_reserve.baseEarnNote: 15 EDGE points per Rs.200 = 7.5 per Rs.100 on domestic spends.

categoryMultipliers.note: 2X EDGE on international spends (30 per Rs.200) up to credit limit. Effective Jun 20 2025.

axis_reserve.milestonesNote: Reserve has no spend-based milestone bonuses despite high annual fee.
axis_reserve.exclusionsNote: Excluded: Utility & Telecom, Rent (capped Rs.1L/month), Wallet, Government, Insurance, Gold/Jewellery, Fuel, Cash advances, Repayments. Effective Jun 20 2025.
axis_reserve.transferPartnersNote: Annual cap 5L EDGE. Marriott, Accor, Qatar REMOVED Apr 2 2026.

categoryMultipliers.note: 5 EDGE Miles per Rs.100 on direct travel — book through airline/hotel directly or via Travel EDGE for the full 5x. Capped at Rs.2L/month, base 2 above.

axis_atlas.exclusionsNote: Excluded from EDGE Miles AND fee waiver: Gold/Jewellery, Rent, Insurance, Wallet, Government, Utilities, Fuel. Effective Jun 20 2025: spend category, not MCC.
axis_atlas.transferPartnersNote: Standard ratio 1 EDGE Mile = 2 partner miles. Marriott, Accor, Qatar REMOVED Apr 2 2026.

amex_platinum_travel.baseEarnNote: 1 MR per Rs.50 = 2 MR per Rs.100. Real INR value: ~0.25 statement credit, ~0.40 Taj voucher, ~0.50 Marriott/airline transfer.

categoryMultipliers.note: 5x-10x MR via Amex Reward Multiplier portal at partner merchants — must route purchase through the RM landing page. Bonus MR cap ~25,000/month (rarely binds in practice).

milestones.reward: 22,500 bonus MR + Rs.10,000 Taj/SeleQtions/Vivanta stay voucher

redemptionTips.tip: Redeem 25,000 MR for Rs.10,000 Taj voucher (Platinum Travel Collection) — yields 0.40 INR/point vs 0.25 for statement credit

amex_platinum_travel.exclusionsNote: Excluded from base MR earn: rent, fuel, insurance, EMI conversions, wallet loads, cash. BUT these still count toward annual milestone targets (1.9L / 4L / 7L) — Amex India quirk.

hdfc_swiggy.baseEarnNote: 1% cashback on most spends; this card models cashback as 1 INR per 'point' for direct rupee comparisons.

categoryMultipliers.note: 10% cashback on Swiggy app spends (Food, Instamart, Dineout, Genie). Monthly cap Rs.1,500 cashback. Per-txn minimum raised to Rs.249 effective 17-Apr-2026 (was Rs.100). Excludes Swiggy Money wallet loads, Minis, Liquor.

5% cashback on online spends (apparel, electronics, dept stores, personal care, local cabs, home decor, pet stores, pharmacies, discount stores, entertainment). Monthly cap Rs.1,500. Excludes flight/hotel bookings.

hdfc_swiggy.exclusionsNote: No cashback on Fuel, Rent, Utilities, Insurance, EMI, Jewellery, Government spends, Wallet loads, Swiggy Money/Minis/Liquor. 5% tier additionally excludes flight/hotel bookings.

devaluations.change: Per-transaction minimum for 10% Swiggy cashback raised from Rs.100 to Rs.249.

icici_amazon_pay.baseEarnNote: 1% cashback on most non-Amazon spends; cashback modelled at 1 INR per 'point' for direct rupee comparisons.

categoryMultipliers.note: 5% cashback on Amazon.in for Prime members (3% for non-Prime). Excludes gold coins, EMI, rent, tax, education on Amazon (post 11-Oct-2025 devaluation).
2% cashback on transactions at 100+ Amazon Pay partner merchants when paid via Amazon Pay (flights, hotels, partner subscriptions, bills routed through Amazon Pay).

icici_amazon_pay.exclusionsNote: Effective 11-Oct-2025: no rewards on rent, tax, education, fuel, utilities, EMI, international (outside Amazon). On Amazon: gold coins, EMI, rent, tax, education excluded. Forex markup cut to 1.99%.

devaluations.change: Cashback exclusions expanded across non-Amazon spends; Amazon-specific exclusions also added. Forex markup cut from 3.5% to 1.99%.
